text.font-family: Virgil, Excalifont, 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', Noteworthy, cursive

svg.text: agent key stolen: $0, the ledger wants the policy signature too

text.font-family: Virgil, Excalifont, 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', Noteworthy, cursive

svg.text: policy key + fooled reader: the float, to listed vendors only

svg.text: both program keys: the float, payments only, no settings change

svg.text: treasury key: everything, which is why no program holds it

text.font-family: Virgil, Excalifont, 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', Noteworthy, cursive
Virgil, Excalifont, 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', Noteworthy, cursive

svg.text: 1 An invoice lands in the inbox (one is poisoned on purpose)

text.font-family: Virgil, Excalifont, 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', Noteworthy, cursive

svg.text: 2 Reader turns it into an intent: vendor, amount, invoice ID

text.font-family: Virgil, Excalifont, 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', Noteworthy, cursive

svg.text: 3 Daemon stores the intent under a nonce and forwards it

text.font-family: Virgil, Excalifont, 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', Noteworthy, cursive

svg.text: 4 Policy checks every rule and builds the exact Payment

text.font-family: Virgil, Excalifont, 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', Noteworthy, cursive

svg.text: 5 Daemon signs only if it matches the stored intent exactly

text.font-family: Virgil, Excalifont, 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', Noteworthy, cursive

svg.text: 6 Policy verifies, co-signs, submits, logs the result code

text.font-family: Virgil, Excalifont, 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', Noteworthy, cursive

svg.text: 7 Ledger checks both signatures and the Payment-only delegation

text.font-family: Virgil, Excalifont, 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', Noteworthy, cursive

svg.text: red = untrusted input · blue, purple = program holding one key · green = ledger account · orange = pre-signed file · yellow = people · gray = observer, no keys
